title: CobblemonEditor
description: Provide an editor for Cobblemon with a visual interface, allowing you to edit your own and other players' teams, including the attributes and forms of wild Pokémon.
body:
# Mod Introduction​
CobblemonEditor is a Pokémon editing mod developed based on the Cobblemon mod. It provides a complete graphical editing process: from choosing the target player's team to editing basic info, moves, nature, abilities, IV/EV, friendship, and other attributes, all of which can be done directly in the game.
## List of commands
/cobblemonedit open <ID>	- Open the specified player's Pokémon editing interface

```
What? No need for command operations? Want item operations like reforging Pokémon? Got it, got it, all taken care of!
```

```
Pokémon Editor - Left Click to edit player/Pokémon, Right Click to edit yourself
```


```
Magpie Editor - Left-click to edit player/Pokémon, right-click to edit yourself
```
